summary: Injured hiker on the Tenmile Trail in the Gore Range; SCRG responded during a weekend with three simultaneous calls
notes: Date from the story's "on Sunday" (the Aug-3/4 Quandary rescue weekend; 2018-08-05 was a Sunday). Tenmile Trail hiker noted as one of three near-simultaneous SCRG calls that weekend alongside ids 561/562. Outcome details not reported in the re-report of the Summit Daily story.
